北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京晴冷干燥，注意保暖补水，愿您一天好心情！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is clear but chilly and dry. Stay warm and hydrated, have a wonderful day!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，气温宜人，出门记得带伞，以防万一哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast with pleasant temperatures. Remember to bring an umbrella, just in case!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗微凉，早晚温差大，请您注意添衣，愿您愉快！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and a bit cool. Mind the temperature change and dress accordingly, enjoy your day!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗暖和，湿度较高，祝您有个阳光又舒服的一天！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is clear and warm with high humidity. Wishing you a sunny and comfortable day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳有雾，能见度低，开车请注意安全，放慢车速哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is foggy with low visibility. Please drive safely and slow down!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，微风习习。出门散步很惬意，别忘带外套！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast with a gentle breeze. Enjoy a pleasant stroll, but don't forget your jacket!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴空万里，气温舒适。记得多喝水，祝您心情舒畅！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear with comfortable temperatures. Remember to drink more water, wishing you a pleasant mood!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，微凉潮湿。出门记得带把伞，心情也要美美的！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, cool, and humid. Bring an umbrella, and keep your spirits bright!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，湿度很高，能见度低，出行请注意交通安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy and humid with low visibility. Please pay attention to traffic safety when traveling!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天微凉，体感较冷，请您穿暖和些，注意补水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and a bit cool, feeling chilly. Please dress warmly and stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，微风阵阵，出门添衣防感冒，愿您开心！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with breezes. Dress warmly to prevent colds, wishing you a happy day!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天寒地冻，请您全副武装，暖暖和和过一天哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is freezing cold. Please bundle up completely and stay warm all day!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -15℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云寒冷，出门记得多穿点，小心别着凉了！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and cold. Remember to wear more clothes when going out, be careful not to catch a cold!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗，微风稍大，体感偏凉，记得多喝水和注意保暖！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is clear with moderate wind, feeling cooler. Remember to drink water and stay warm!
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗舒适，湿度较高，享受阳光，保持好心情哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear and comfortable with high humidity. Enjoy the sunshine and keep a good mood!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，气温偏低，驾车请慢行，注意保暖和安全！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and cool. Please drive slowly, pay attention to staying warm and safe!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾，空气质量不佳，请做好防护，注意添衣！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has haze and poor air quality. Please take protective measures and dress warmly!
